round: R05 adaptive evidence fusion, full real-LLM benchmark

online_only_scope: No Residual score or Residual acceptance/veto; retains Anchor and other structural protection, not an offline-free optimizer
offline_memory: R04 fixed cases for context reference only; no transfer of old shortlist action values to new candidate/action space

cross_arm_objective_cache: Exact request coordinates/shape and stochastic RNG; no API response replay from earlier rounds
